My doctor told me a story about two patients of hers, one who was skinny and the other who was obese. The obese one eats veggies every day while the skinny one is always eating pizza. The obese one goes biking regularly, while the skinny one never does. Who has had unhealthy habits recently?

B. Cannot answer
